scenes.headline: How forty layers share four memory banks
scenes.sub: Intern-S2-Mobius keeps knowledge in shared memory and reasoning in the layers.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Souffle! Intern-S2-Mobius is a thirty-five-billion-parameter model that pulls a transformer apart into memory and reasoning. Here's how.

scenes.text: Knowledge lives in a few shared memory banks of experts, and every layer queries one. Forty layers share four banks instead of owning one each.
scenes.say: Knowledge lives in a few shared banks of experts, and every layer queries one. Forty layers share four banks, instead of each owning its own.

left.title: A standard MoE
items: Layer k owns expert bank k
What a layer learned lives only there
left.say: In a standard mixture of experts, each layer owns its experts. Whatever layer k learned lives only in layer k.

right.title: Mobius
items: 4 banks, each a router and 2560 experts
Any depth can query the same knowledge
right.say: Mobius builds just four banks, each a router and two thousand five hundred sixty experts. A layer near the input and one near the output can query the same knowledge.

scenes.title: One four-layer cycle, repeated ten times

steps.say: Each of the forty layers keeps its own attention and norms, but borrows its experts from a shared bank.

steps.note: layer mod 4 picks the bank: layers 0, 4, 8 … 36 share one
steps.say: The layer number, mod four, picks the bank. Layers zero, four, eight, up to thirty-six all route into the very same weights.

steps.note: full_attention_interval: 4, the same period as the banks
steps.say: Attention cycles on the same period: three Gated DeltaNet linear layers, then one full attention layer. So bank three always sits with full attention.

steps.note: one straight pass, no runtime loop
steps.say: It's one straight pass, not a loop. Attend, then query a shared bank, ten times over at increasing depth.

scenes.title: How many times shorter the reasoning traces get
scenes.note: against a matched Transformer baseline; throughput gains track these
scenes.say: The speedup is mostly fewer tokens. Traces get five times shorter on GPQA Diamond, but only one point two on HMMT, where throughput barely moves.

scenes.text: Four shared banks, ten layers each: knowledge stops being tied to depth. The speed comes mostly from shorter traces, not cheaper tokens.
scenes.mark: knowledge stops being tied to depth
scenes.say: Four shared banks, ten layers each, and knowledge stops being tied to depth. The speed comes mostly from shorter traces, not cheaper tokens.

recap: Knowledge in 4 shared banks of experts
scenes.say: To recap: four shared memory banks, forty layers taking turns, and speed that comes from shorter traces.
